gold.user: User wants to initiate a SIP recording for a specific call using their Twilio account. They provide the AccountSid and CallSid to identify the call and specify any additional parameters needed for the SIP recording.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully create a SIP recording for the specified call and return a confirmation response with the details of the recording.

gold.user: User needs to update the settings of an existing SIP recording for a call. They have the AccountSid, CallSid, and the Sid of the SIP recording they want to modify, along with the new settings they wish to apply.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the SIP recording with the new settings and return a response confirming the update along with the updated details.
